polar-derivative.def: The slope of a polar curve $r = f(\theta)$: $\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/d\theta}{dx/d\theta}$, with $x = r\cos\theta$ and $y = r\sin\theta$, where $\frac{dx}{d\theta} \ne 0$. Not to be confused with $\frac{dr}{d\theta}$, the rate of change of $r$, the signed distance from the pole.
